note: state/parks-outbox/<epoch>-<pid>-<rand>.tsv: one 12-column parks note per file, written tmp+mv by bin/lib/parks-write.sh pw_note and deleted by pw_flush only after a 200 from PUT /api/parks for exactly that batch; .bad/ holds a batch the worker refused (400), .fail-log the epoch of the last failure line. The D1 parks table is the record. Bounded by PW_OUTBOX_MAX (10000): over it the oldest notes are deleted and pw_flush writes the marker .dropped-at (one epoch line); the resolver's _brp_cursor reads a cursor older than that marker as 0, so the next tick backfills. Machine-local, never carried

state/parks-conductor/<project>.tsv: ck and state|head|reason|url of each BLOCKED_HUMAN or RED_TWICE row pw_conductor_sync (bin/lib/parks-write.sh) last noted, written tmp+mv at each conductor tick end. One file per project, no growth. Losing it re-notes the current parks once (an idempotent upsert). The resolver mirror and cursor (state/blocked-resolver/parks/) and the conductor delta stamps (state/merge-conductor/parks-delta/) live under their lanes' own state dirs, which this catalog does not split (a path here is one name)
